name: visor-v2
description: A secure MCP browser runtime for AI agents.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @visor/extension && npm run build -w @visor/mcp-server
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @visor/protocol && npm run build -w @visor/schemas && npm run build -w @visor/privacy && npm run build -w @visor/extractor && npm run build -w @visor/compiler
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
